text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahraini labour minister says 30,000 jobs to be available for young people by the year 2000.
- State Security Court jails 15 people for up to 15 years for involvement in an attempt to topple the government.
- Bahrain opens direct air link with Spain. Air Europa, a private Spanish airline to increase charter flights to six a week from two.
- Gulf Cooperation Council welcomes a decision by Bahrain and Qatar to open an embassy in each other's capitals.
- A joint Bahraini-Omani-Kuwaiti committee to be formed to follow up listing of companies in the three countries. The decision followed a meeting in Kuwait between bourse officials.
